background: JPMorgan Chase & Co. is the holding company of the largest US bank, spanning consumer and community banking, the corporate and investment bank, commercial banking and asset and wealth management.
synthesis: All three main agencies rate the holding company, A+ on average with the weakest at A, all on a stable outlook; the last move was a one-notch upgrade by one of the three on 15 Nov 2024. CET1 of 14.2% is above the US peer median and Tier 1 leverage of 6.6% just below it. No rating action has been taken in the last 90 days; the operating bank beneath it is rated higher.
